about: Whether a reporting standard the project answers to would refuse a sentence: a ranking called an optimum (ISO 55001 Cl. 6), a benefit asserted as realised, a cost total silent on how overhaul is treated (IAS 16 para 12), a count of observations described as assets, or a recommendation carrying no objective, owner or measure (ISO 55001 Cl. 6.2.1). Scored against scripts/standards_lint.refuses. English and Arabic. On 23 October 2026 blind_v1 (36 cases, on which the first rules scored 0% recall) moved into dev and the rules were rewritten as linguistic families against it; blind_v2 was written independently that day and is the blind split.

dev.text: The model produces the optimal maintenance schedule for the fleet.
Our ranking optimises spend across the 180 assets.
This approach maximises availability within the current budget.
النموذج يحدد الجدول الأمثل للصيانة.
The programme saved USD 4.2 million in the first year.
Preventive scheduling reduced costs by 12% across the depot.
The pilot delivered savings of USD 300,000.
وفّرنا 1.2 مليون درهم خلال الربع الأول.
Total maintenance cost for the period was USD 50.4 million.
Maintenance expenditure of USD 50,430,446 is reported below.
إجمالي تكاليف الصيانة بلغ 50.4 مليون دولار.
289 high-risk assets require intervention this cycle.
There are 3,950 overdue work orders on 120 critical assets.
289 أصول عالية المخاطر تحتاج تدخلاً.
We recommend replacing the pumping station bearings.
Compressor 14 should be prioritised.
نوصي باستبدال المحامل في محطة الضخ.
It is recommended that the depot defer the overhaul.
The ranking orders assets by predicted risk and consequence; it is not an optimal allocation.
A priority order is not an optimum and must not be described as one.
The programme is expected to save USD 4.2 million, which has not yet been realised.
Proposed savings are estimates and no saving has been demonstrated.
الوفورات مقترحة ولم تتحقق بعد.
Maintenance spend is split between routine servicing, charged to profit or loss, and overhaul capitalised under IAS 16.
Routine repairs are expensed; the major inspection is treated as a separate component.
289 high-risk observations were recorded, not 289 distinct assets.
The 3,950 figure counts overdue status observations rather than assets.
289 ملاحظة عالية المخاطر، وليست 289 أصلاً.
We recommend prioritising compressor 14 to protect the 97% availability objective, owned by the depot manager.
Bearings should be replaced before Q3 to meet the downtime target, with the reliability engineer accountable.
نوصي بإعطاء الأولوية للضاغط 14 لتحقيق هدف الجاهزية، والمالك هو مدير المستودع.
Mean availability across the period was 96.8%.
The dataset holds 5,000 dated observations of 180 assets.
Downtime totalled 91,074 hours over three calendar years.
متوسط الجاهزية بلغ 96.8% خلال الفترة.
This section describes the method, not its results.
The plan represents the ideal allocation of inspection crews across the network.
